web-scrape.description: Scrape one known URL and return any combination of HTML, Markdown, a screenshot, page images, original bytes, CSS-selected fields, relevant highlights, schema-shaped JSON, or product data. Supports browser actions, custom target headers, PDF parsing, deadlines, and zero data retention. Browser clicks can change the target site's state. Use web-search when the URL is unknown, web-map for URLs only, web-crawl for linked pages, or submit-batch for large asynchronous jobs.

url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS URL to scrape.

json.description: An object matching `jsonParams.schema`, extracted from the page.

product.description: Product details such as name, price, and availability.

formats.description: Outputs to return. Set at least one to `true`.

includeLinks.description: Keep link URLs in the Markdown. Set false to return link text without URLs.

includeImages.description: Include images in the Markdown using image syntax with URLs and alt text.

inlineImages.description: How base64 images appear: `placeholder` (default) or `preserve`. Requires `includeImages`.

selector.description: CSS selector matching exactly one visible element.

x.description: Left edge of the capture, in pixels from the document origin.

y.description: Top edge of the capture, in pixels from the document origin.

width.description: Width of the capture in pixels.

height.description: Height of the capture in pixels.

anyOf.description: Pixels from the document origin.

area.description: What to capture: `viewport`, `fullPage`, one element, or a rectangle. Max 40 megapixels.

enrich.description: Extra data per image: `dimensions`, `classification`, or a hosted `file` URL.

dedupe.description: Set `visual` to drop visual duplicates, keeping the largest copy.

selector.description: CSS selector to match within the current page or parent rule.

type.description: Return the first match with `item` or all matches with `list`.

output.description: Return text, HTML, an attribute such as `@href`, or nested field rules. Defaults to text.

rules.description: Field names mapped to CSS selectors (`h1`, `a@href`) or rule objects. Max 100 fields, 5 levels.

parseParams.description: Requires `formats.parse: true`; required when it is set.

query.description: The question or topic to find passages for.

maxCharacters.description: Maximum combined length of returned passages.

highlightsParams.description: Requires `formats.highlights: true`; required when it is set.

schema.description: JSON Schema (not an example object) for a top-level object, up to 50 KB. Use optional or nullable fields for missing facts.

instructions.description: Extra guidance, such as which facts to prefer or how to read a field.

jsonParams.description: Requires `formats.json: true`; required when it is set.

dedupeImages.description: Drop visually duplicate product images, keeping the largest copy.

country.description: Proxy country as a two-letter code, such as `US`. Case-insensitive.

headers.description: HTTP headers to send to the target site. Requests with headers skip the cache.

viewport.description: Browser size in pixels. Omit for 1920 × 1080. When provided, missing dimensions default to 1440 × 900.

theme.description: Emulate a light or dark color scheme.

dismissCookies.description: Accept cookie banners before actions and capture.

dismissPopups.description: Close other popups before actions and capture.

type.description: Use `perform` for a plain-language browser instruction.

action.description: One browser instruction, such as clicking a button or entering text.

type.description: Use `scroll` to move through the page or a container.

amount.description: Distance per scroll: pixels, one `viewport`, or `max` to reach the end.

selector.description: Scroll this container. Omit to scroll the page.

maxScrolls.description: Maximum number of scroll steps for this action.

type.description: Use `wait` to pause for a fixed duration.

milliseconds.description: Time to pause in milliseconds before the next action.

type.description: Use `waitFor` to wait for a matching element.

selector.description: CSS selector to wait for before continuing.

actions.description: Browser steps run in order before capture. Requires a paid plan. Skips the cache.

waitFor.description: Milliseconds, or a CSS selector to wait for, after actions. Defaults to 500 (2000 with frames or XML).

settleAnimations.description: Wait for CSS animations to finish before capture. Defaults to `true` when `screenshot` is requested.

mainContentOnly.description: Keep only the main content. Doesn't affect `screenshot`, `bytes`, or `product`.

includeSelectors.description: Keep only elements matching these CSS selectors.

excludeSelectors.description: Remove elements matching these CSS selectors. Overrides `includeSelectors`.

includeFrames.description: Include iframe content in HTML and text outputs. Screenshots always show visible frames.

startPage.description: First page to parse, starting at 1.

endPage.description: Last page to parse. Must be at least `startPage`.

ocr.description: Set `auto` to read scanned pages with OCR.

sharedParams.description: Browser and content settings shared by all outputs.

maxAgeMs.description: Maximum age of a cached output, in milliseconds. `0` fetches fresh. Defaults to 3 days (259200000 ms). Maximum: 1 year (31536000000 ms).

zdr.description: `enabled` turns on zero data retention. Your organization must have ZDR enabled.

behavior.description: "fail" returns 408 at the deadline. "return-partial" returns available results; inspect the response’s partial flag. "return-partial" requires at least 5000 ms.

timeoutOpts.description: Deadline for the whole request. Defaults to 90000 ms with `fail`. Fixed waits must end before it.

tags.description: Labels for tracking request usage. Not retained when zdr is enabled.

web-map.description: Map a website's URLs using Context's index, with available page titles, descriptions, keywords, and languages. Filter by URL pattern or search phrase without retrieving every page body. Use web-scrape for one page, web-crawl for content from several pages, or submit-batch for large asynchronous collection.

maxLinks.description: Maximum number of URLs to return.

sitemapUrl.description: Fetch this sitemap instead of discovering sitemaps. Must belong to the domain or a subdomain.

urlRegex.description: Optional RE2-compatible regex pattern. Only URLs matching this pattern are returned and counted against maxLinks.

search.description: Filter URLs by a topic or phrase, most relevant first.

headers.description: HTTP headers for the target origin. Non-empty headers bypass caching.

behavior.description: "fail" returns 408 at the deadline. "return-partial" returns available results; inspect the response’s partial flag.

timeoutOpts.description: Request deadline and what to return when it passes.

zdr.description: `enabled` turns on zero data retention. Returns 403 `ZDR_NOT_ENABLED` unless your organization has ZDR.

tags.description: Comma-separated labels for filtering usage, e.g. `production,team-alpha`.

web-crawl.description: Start from a URL, follow relevant internal links, and return clean Markdown for multiple pages in one synchronous request. Use this for focused multi-page research when results are needed immediately. Use web-map for URLs only or submit-batch for large jobs that should run asynchronously.

maxDepth.description: Maximum link depth from the starting URL (0 = only the starting page)

urlRegex.description: Regex pattern. Only URLs matching this pattern will be followed and scraped. An automatic prefix scope in the form ^<starting URL> follows a redirect of the starting page.

includeLinks.description: Preserve hyperlinks in the Markdown output

includeImages.description: Include image references in the Markdown output

shortenBase64Images.description: Truncate base64-encoded image data in the Markdown output

useMainContentOnly.description: Extract only the main content, stripping headers, footers, sidebars, and navigation

followSubdomains.description: When true, follow links on subdomains of the starting URL's domain (e.g. docs.example.com when starting from example.com). www and apex are always treated as equivalent.

shouldParse.description: When true, PDF pages are fetched and parsed. When false, PDF pages are skipped entirely (not included in results and not counted as failures).

ocr.description: Read scanned PDF pages with OCR; preserve pages that already contain text.

start.description: First 1-based PDF page to parse. When omitted, parsing starts at the first page.

end.description: Last 1-based PDF page to parse. When omitted, parsing ends at the last page. Must be greater than or equal to start when both are provided.

pdf.description: PDF handling. `start`/`end` limit parsing to an inclusive, 1-based page range.

includeFrames.description: When true, the contents of iframes are rendered to Markdown for each crawled page.

includeSelectors.description: Keep matching HTML subtrees before converting each page to Markdown.

excludeSelectors.description: Remove matching elements after inclusions. Exclusions take precedence.

maxAgeMs.description: Maximum cache age in milliseconds. Defaults to 1 day; `0` fetches fresh.

waitForMs.description: Browser wait time in milliseconds after initial page load for each crawled page. Defaults to 3500 (3.5 seconds). Min: 0. Max: 30000 (30 seconds).

settleAnimations.description: Wait briefly for CSS animations and transitions to settle before reading each page.

stopAfterMs.description: Soft crawl deadline in milliseconds. Returns pages collected before the next deadline check.

behavior.description: "fail" returns 408 at the deadline. "return-partial" returns available results; inspect the response’s partial flag.

timeoutOpts.description: Request deadline and what to return when it passes.

zdr.description: `enabled` turns on zero data retention. Returns 403 `ZDR_NOT_ENABLED` unless your organization has ZDR.

tags.description: Labels for filtering usage in the dashboard.

web-search.description: Search the live web and optionally return Markdown or query-relevant highlights for ranked results in the same call. Use this to discover sources, answer current questions, or research a topic when the exact page URL is unknown. When a URL is already known, use web-scrape instead. Use web-answers when the user wants a sourced JSON answer rather than ranked links.

query.description: Search query. Accepts natural language as well as Google-style search operators such as `site:`, `-site:`, `inurl:`, `intitle:`, quoted phrases, and `OR`.

numResults.description: Number of results to request and return (10–100). Defaults to 10.

includeDomains.description: Allowlist — only return results from these domains. Up to 100 domains. Example: ["arxiv.org", "github.com"].

excludeDomains.description: Blocklist — drop results from these domains. Up to 100 domains. Example: ["pinterest.com", "reddit.com"].

freshness.description: Restrict results to content published within this window.

country.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to localize results to a specific country (maps to Google's `gl` parameter). Example: "us", "gb", "de".

enabled.description: Scrape each result to Markdown. Adds 1 credit per 10 results.

includeImages.description: Emit image references in the Markdown.

shortenBase64Images.description: Truncate inline base64 image payloads to keep responses small.

useMainContentOnly.description: Strip nav, header, footer, and sidebar — keep only the primary article content.

shouldParse.description: Parse PDF URLs. When false, PDF results are skipped with WEBSITE_ACCESS_ERROR.

start.description: First PDF page to parse (1-based, inclusive). Defaults to page 1.

end.description: Last PDF page to parse (1-based, inclusive). Defaults to the final page. Must be >= start.

pdf.description: PDF handling. Use start/end to bound text extraction and OCR to a page range.

includeFrames.description: Render iframe contents into the Markdown.

maxAgeMs.description: Maximum cache age in milliseconds for result page content. Defaults to 180 days (15552000000 ms) when Markdown is requested, or 365 days (31536000000 ms) when only highlights are requested. Explicit values override either default. Maximum: 365 days. Set to 0 to force a fresh scrape.

enabled.description: Return relevant passages for each result. Adds 1 credit per 10 results.

maxCharacters.description: Maximum combined length of passages per result.

highlightsOptions.description: Passages from each result page that are relevant to the query. Pages are read with the `markdownOptions` settings.

Use web-search when ranked links or snippets are enough, or web-scrape with jsonParams when the source URL and extraction schema are already known.

input.description: Batch job definition. Choose a scrape or crawl mode and provide the URLs, output format, and processing options for that mode.

webhookUrl.description: Legacy URL notified when the batch finishes. Preserves one best-effort attempt. Cannot be combined with webhook.

url.description: Public HTTP(S) URL that receives batch completion, failure, or cancellation events.

delays_seconds.description: Retry delays in seconds, totaling at most 72 hours. Use [] to disable automatic retries.

retry.description: Webhook retry settings. Use {} for the default schedule.

webhook.description: Where to send the batch's final-status event. Omit `retry` for one attempt; `{}` uses the default retry schedule.

tags.description: Tags stored on the batch. Filter the batch list by them later.

list-batches.description: List asynchronous scraping batches from newest to oldest, with status, search, tag, and cursor filters. Use this to find a batch ID or review account activity; it does not return page-level results.

q.description: Free-text search term, matched against the batch id, crawl source (start URL or sitemap domain), and tags.

search_type.description: `prefix` for as-you-type prefix matching (default), `exact` for full-token matching.

tags.description: Comma-separated list of tags to filter by (matches batches having any of them).

get-batch.description: Retrieve one batch's status, progress, timing, credit accounting, errors, and download links when complete. Poll this after submit-batch; use get-batch-results only after the batch has completed.

get-batch-results.description: Page through the successful and failed URL results of a completed batch as JSON. Use the returned cursor to continue when more results exist. For progress before completion, use get-batch instead.

limit.description: Records per page. Defaults to 25. A page can close early so its payload stays under ~8 MB; rely on next_cursor rather than counting records.

cancel-batch.description: Stop a queued or running batch from starting additional pages. Work already in progress finishes and unused reserved credits are refunded after settlement. This does not delete stored results; use only when the user explicitly wants processing stopped.

delete-batch.description: Permanently delete a completed, cancelled, or failed batch and its stored results. Active batches must be cancelled and allowed to settle first. This cannot be undone; use only when the user explicitly requests deletion.

create-monitor.description: Create a recurring monitor for a page, sitemap, or structured extraction target. Use this when the user wants ongoing change detection, not a one-time scrape. Configure the target, schedule, change detection, and optional webhook; Context immediately runs an initial baseline and returns the monitor.

name.description: Human-readable monitor name used to identify it in lists, runs, changes, and notifications.

tags.description: Labels for filtering monitors, their changes, and their usage.

type.description: Use `page` to watch one web page.

url.description: Public HTTP(S) page URL to monitor.

instructions.description: Plain-language goal describing which page changes matter. When provided without change_detection, semantic detection is inferred.

normalize_whitespace.description: Normalize whitespace before comparing or analyzing text.

include_selectors.description: Monitor these CSS-selected regions. Empty or omitted uses main content. Changes create a new baseline.

exclude_selectors.description: Remove matching regions after inclusions. Changes create a new baseline.

do.description: Use `wait` to pause for a fixed duration.

timeMs.description: Time to pause in milliseconds before the next action.

run-monitor-now.description: Queue an immediate check for a monitor outside its regular schedule. This starts an asynchronous network run, may advance the monitor's stored comparison baseline, and can notify its configured external webhook when a change is detected. Use get-monitor-run or list-monitor-runs to follow its outcome. Paused monitors return 409 MONITOR_PAUSED. Setting status=active with update-monitor already runs the monitor promptly; don't call run-monitor-now right after resuming or its run may be skipped as superseded.

Idempotency-Key.description: Unique key to prevent duplicate retry requests.

force.description: Resend even if the delivery already succeeded. Defaults to false.

list-logs.description: List recent API requests from the authenticated Context account, newest first. Filter by time, endpoint path, API key ID, HTTP status, error code, tags, or request content. Use errors_only to investigate failures, then pass the request_id from a data entry to get-log for the retained request and response. Defaults to the last 24 hours and does not create another usage-log entry.

from.description: Only include requests at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp. Defaults to 24 hours before `to`.

to.description: Only include requests at or before this ISO 8601 timestamp. Defaults to now.

path.description: Filter by endpoint path, with or without the /v1 prefix.

key_id.description: Filter by the API key that made the request.

status_code.description: Filter by exact HTTP status code.

error_code.description: Filter by the `error_code` returned in the response.

errors_only.description: Only include requests that returned a 4xx or 5xx status.

tags.description: Comma-separated request tags. Matches requests carrying any of them. Up to 20 tags, each 1-50 characters.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the request query and body, e.g. a domain.

limit.description: Number of log entries per page.

get-log.description: Retrieve one API request from the authenticated Context account by the request_id in a list-logs data entry, including its redacted retained input, response, timing, credits, status, and user agent. Zero-data-retention requests contain metadata but no retained input or response.

request_id.description: The request ID of the logged API call.

submit-feedback.description: Report a Context problem to the Context team. Always use this when a tool or API behaves unexpectedly, including wrong or incomplete successful results, unexpected errors, or a docs mismatch, even after a successful workaround. Never use it for account limits working as intended: 401 USAGE_EXCEEDED, 429 RATE_LIMITED, or 403 PAID_PLAN_REQUIRED. Send a category, a note describing the affected tool and expected versus actual behavior, and the affected request_id, a relevant public url, or both. Use a url when no request_id is available; never invent an ID. Sanitize secrets and private data. Costs no credits. Report each distinct issue once; reporting the same request_id again returns the original feedback_id. If this tool fails, do not recursively report its failure or loop on retries.

request_id.description: The request_id of the API call the feedback is about, from its response body or X-Request-Id header.

note.description: What went wrong and what you expected instead.

url.description: The page the feedback is about, such as one page of a crawl or a docs page.

tags.description: Labels for filtering usage in the dashboard.
